name: Kanban CRM – Teknora
author: Juliana Rodrigues Guimarães

sections.description:
Kanban CRM – Teknora is a lightweight and intuitive plugin designed to help businesses, freelancers and teams organize tasks, manage processes and improve productivity — without complexity.

✔ Visual Kanban board
✔ Drag-and-drop tasks
✔ Clean and modern interface
✔ Lightweight and fast
✔ Ready for CRM and lead management

🎯 Simple. Visual. Efficient.

Features

  • Visual Kanban board
  • Task creation and management
  • Drag-and-drop workflow
  • Clean and intuitive UI
  • Fast and lightweight performance
  • Scalable structure for CRM, leads and KPI tools

Who is it for?

  • Small businesses
  • Freelancers
  • Agencies
  • Sales teams
  • Project managers
  • Anyone who needs organization and control

Why Teknora Kanban?

Unlike complex tools, Teknora Kanban focuses on simplicity and performance.

It is part of a growing ecosystem that will include CRM, lead management and KPI dashboards — all inside WordPress.

Description (Português)

Plugin Kanban gratuito para WordPress.

O Kanban CRM – Teknora permite organizar tarefas, gerenciar processos e aumentar a produtividade com um sistema visual simples e eficiente.

✔ Quadro Kanban visual
✔ Arrastar e soltar tarefas
✔ Interface limpa e moderna
✔ Leve e rápido
✔ Preparado para CRM e gestão de leads

Descripción (Español)

Plugin Kanban gratuito para WordPress.

Kanban CRM – Teknora permite organizar tareas, gestionar procesos y mejorar la productividad con un sistema visual simple y eficiente.

✔ Tablero Kanban visual
✔ Arrastrar y soltar tareas
✔ Interfaz limpia y moderna
✔ Ligero y rápido
✔ Preparado para CRM y gestión de leads
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Kanban CRM – Teknora”
  4. Click Install Now
  5. Click Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the .zip file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

After Activation

  1. A new menu Teknora Kanban will appear in your dashboard
  2. Access the Kanban board
  3. Start creating tasks and organizing your workflow
sections.faq:
Where do I access the Kanban board?

After activation, access it through the “Teknora Kanban” menu in your dashboard.

Can I use it as a CRM?

Yes. The plugin is designed to evolve into a complete CRM and business management system.

Is it beginner friendly?

Yes. No technical knowledge required.

Does it support drag-and-drop?

Yes. Tasks can be moved visually between stages.
